note: Drive folder actually contains 685 specimen subfolders, not ~785 as estimated in the task brief.
coverage_caveat: Only 8 of 685 JSON metadata files were actually downloaded and parsed in this session (plus 1 additional JSON read during reliability testing, Aphaenogaster_lepida_CASENT0743786, also voxel_size=2.44 µm, not included in the 8 above). The download_file_content MCP tool only accepts one fileId per call with no batch/bulk mode, so downloading and decoding all 685 JSONs individually was impractical within this session's context/turn budget. All 8 (9 including the test file) sampled JSONs report the identical voxel_size value "2.44 µm", consistent with a single fixed scanner calibration setting across the corpus, but this is NOT confirmed for all 685 specimens.
